version.changelog: Sync skill instructions, references, and helper from GitHub a91c30113b1827d719267576bbd2936c99a28029

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed public research workflow that uses a scoped Crawlora API helper to collect search and social evidence for topic validation.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to Crawlora and public data sources are expected for the research purpose, and the helper restricts routes and methods to the documented topic-validation catalog.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, package manager step, dependency install, service setup, or tool replacement was present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs use of a shell helper but also tells the agent to keep samples bounded, preserve source limits, stop on authentication errors, avoid bypassing rate limits or challenges, and avoid overclaiming from the data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The helper creates a temporary curl config for the API key with restrictive permissions and removes it on exit; no persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, or system modification was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is topic demand validation using autocomplete, trends, SERP, and bounded public social samples; the bundled endpoint reference and helper support that same purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that your topic queries and Crawlora API key will be used to call Crawlora's external API. Keep searches to non-sensitive public research topics, review Crawlora's service terms/privacy posture for your use case, and set an API budget because successful calls may be billable.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill uses a shell helper, but the helper is narrow: fixed base URL, route and method allowlists, path validation, and safer curl handling. Lack of explicit allowed-tools metadata is a hardening note, not a material mismatch.
[E1] expected: External transmission to https://api.crawlora.net/api/v1 is disclosed in the skill, helper, and endpoint reference and is central to the skill's public search/social research function.
[PE2] expected: The cited chmod 600 only restricts permissions on a temporary curl config containing the API key; it does not invoke sudo, root execution, or privilege escalation.
